kind.description: Use stocks for named stock comparisons, industry_peers for a stock versus its own registered industry peers, stock_indexes for one stock against one or more indexes, or previous to keep the previous comparison set.

stock_mentions.description: Exact A-share company names or codes in the current message. Copy every explicitly asked-for stock. With industry_peers or stock_indexes, supply only the anchor if named. With previous, pass [].

subject_source.description: Use context if the user refers to a stock or comparison set from this conversation. Use message if the user names the entire set or the industry anchor.

trading_days.description: Explicit trading-day count (5, 10, 20, 60). Pass 0 when the user omits it, or -1 for explicit unsupported time ranges.

industry_index.description: Include or exclude the anchor stock's SW level-2 index. Use keep to leave the selection unchanged.

broad_index_add.description: Verbatim names or full symbols in the latest message for benchmarks to add. Supported: 沪深300 (000300.SH), 中证500 (000905.SH), 中证1000 (000852.SH). Use [] if none.

broad_index_remove.description: Verbatim names or full symbols in the latest message for the registered benchmarks to remove. Use [] if none.

clear_broad_indexes.description: Use clear when the user asks to remove every broad index. Otherwise use keep.

default_broad_index.description: Include CSI 300 if the user generically asks for a broad market benchmark or 大盘, exclude if the user asks to remove the default benchmark. For a named index use broad_index_add or broad_index_remove with keep here.

window_change.description: When trading_days is 0 and a user loosely requests a longer or shorter lookback, move to the adjacent supported window. Otherwise use keep.

advice.description: Use declined only if the user separately asked for investment advice alongside this historical comparison.
